properties.name: Construction Pro Manager
properties.description:
Andrew Arena created a project management software that truly serves the needs of project managers, construction companies, clients, subcontractors and all other project participants. 

Construction Pro Manager requires very little training, is intuitive and logical to a project manager and has a clearly organized system for document storage and retrieval. Best of all, it was designed to be affordable for small to mid-size construction firms. 

The central element of Construction Pro Manager is its patent-pending CLS-Contractor Linked System. It starts with three primary filing categories that are familiar to all project managers: Administrative, Technical and Field. Within each of these are a total of 42 construction-based logs and 23 essential forms, breakdowns and scheduling modules, which is an organizational structure that project managers and contractors already know intuitively, so they don’t need to learn an entirely new system or way of thinking.

The CLS-Contractor Linked System makes it easy to file and quickly retrieve such documents as project schedule, insurance, purchase order, requisition, request for proposal, email, operational & maintenance manual, contract drawings, equipment training, punch list, scope of work, accident report, daily time sheet, safety violation, inspection report and many others.

Construction Pro Manager is a password-protected, cloud-based application that can be used from desktop and laptop computers as well as with its view-only mobile application for smartphones and tablets.

It is subscription-based software that costs only $125–$175 per month, with annual, biannual and recurring monthly subscription options. Each subscription includes unlimited users per each contractor client, unlimited projects per each contractor client and daily technical support.

Construction Pro Manager was launched during 2014, and complete information about the product can be found at www.constructionpromanager.com.

Structly is built for construction companies that want stronger project control, better coordination, earlier signals, and a more systematic way to improve performance from planning to delivery.

Project Site Solutions specializes in providing our customers with the large variety of services needed to make their project or business site operations successful. Our customers want to focus on their project delivery and core business operations while having confidence that all the support services, safety, security and compliance issues are managed.

The Challenge: The variety and number of business and project sites in Australia is increasing rapidly. At the same time the regulatory environment is continually evolving. Litigation for compliance violations is on the rise for employment eligibility, occupational health and safety, insurance liability, and security. In the face of these challenges Australian companies are facing costly challenges in managing their supply chain for the indirect services needed to support their core operations.

The Impact: The increased costs of these indirect but mandatory services leach profitability of the core business. Managing the increasing number of suppliers and services from RFI/RFP to contract fullfillment is expensive. Many of the suppliers are niche providers. Traditional Facilities Management companies have not evolved to meet the challenge, and the increased burden of management, the associated costs, and the business risk fall to you, all at a time when focus on your core business and profitability are essential.

Andrew Arena created a project management software that truly serves the needs of project managers, construction companies, clients, subcontractors and all other project participants. 

Construction Pro Manager requires very little training, is intuitive and logical to a project manager and has a clearly organized system for document storage and retrieval. Best of all, it was designed to be affordable for small to mid-size construction firms. 

The central element of Construction Pro Manager is its patent-pending CLS-Contractor Linked System. It starts with three primary filing categories that are familiar to all project managers: Administrative, Technical and Field. Within each of these are a total of 42 construction-based logs and 23 essential forms, breakdowns and scheduling modules, which is an organizational structure that project managers and contractors already know intuitively, so they don’t need to learn an entirely new system or way of thinking.

The CLS-Contractor Linked System makes it easy to file and quickly retrieve such documents as project schedule, insurance, purchase order, requisition, request for proposal, email, operational & maintenance manual, contract drawings, equipment training, punch list, scope of work, accident report, daily time sheet, safety violation, inspection report and many others.

Construction Pro Manager is a password-protected, cloud-based application that can be used from desktop and laptop computers as well as with its view-only mobile application for smartphones and tablets.

It is subscription-based software that costs only $125–$175 per month, with annual, biannual and recurring monthly subscription options. Each subscription includes unlimited users per each contractor client, unlimited projects per each contractor client and daily technical support.

Construction Pro Manager was launched during 2014, and complete information about the product can be found at www.constructionpromanager.com.

ProjectVIEW ERP is not a generic ERP adapted for construction.

messages.content:
You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.
  - Shopify ↔ an online-store/e-commerce platform: true.
  - Shopify ↔ a payment processor with no storefront platform: false.
  - Grab ↔ a ride-hailing marketplace: true.
  - Grab ↔ a traditional car-rental operator with no on-demand marketplace: false.
  - Rippling ↔ a smaller HRIS/payroll platform: true.
  - Rippling ↔ device-security software for mobile workers: false.
  - Brex ↔ a corporate-card and spend-management platform: true.
  - Brex ↔ consumer personal-finance budgeting software: false.
  - OpenAI ↔ a foundation-model/API company: true.
  - OpenAI ↔ a consultancy that implements AI tools for clients: false.
  - Datadog ↔ an application-performance-monitoring and observability platform: true.
  - Datadog ↔ a generic IT consulting firm: false.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ an endpoint-security platform: true.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ a general-purpose IT monitoring tool with no security product: false.
  - Procore ↔ construction project-management software: true.
  - Procore ↔ a construction contractor: false.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ field-service management software for trades businesses: true.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ a plumbing company that uses field-service software: false.
  - Teladoc ↔ a virtual-care/telehealth platform: true.
  - Teladoc ↔ a health-insurance carrier with no telehealth product: false.
  - Veeva ↔ life-sciences CRM or clinical-operations software: true.
  - Veeva ↔ a generic CRM with no life-sciences focus: false.

entity.name: Corfix
entity.description:
Corfix is construction safety software purpose-built for contractors across North America. We bring digital safety forms, construction timekeeping, worker certifications, incident reporting, job scheduling, and jobsite documentation together into one mobile platform that works on any smartphone or browser your crew already uses.

Most contractors come to Corfix from one of three places: paper-based systems that can't scale, a collection of point solutions that don't talk to each other, or enterprise platforms that were built for someone else's business. The result is a field team working around their tools instead of with them, and an office that's always a step behind.

Corfix was founded by people who spent years in the field before building software, which means the platform reflects how construction actually works rather than how someone imagined it might. Workers complete forms, clock in, schedule shifts, access safety resources, and report incidents from a single app. Supervisors and office staff get real-time visibility into compliance status, hours, certifications, and project documentation without chasing anyone down.

From specialty subcontractors to large general contracting operations, Corfix helps contractors meet safety certification requirements including COR, reduce administrative overhead, eliminate payroll disputes, and build a safety culture that holds up under audit, without the cost and complexity that makes enterprise software a poor fit for most of the industry.

Learn how Corfix can work for your team at corfix.com.

entity.name: Construction Pro Manager
entity.description:
Andrew Arena created a project management software that truly serves the needs of project managers, construction companies, clients, subcontractors and all other project participants. 

Construction Pro Manager requires very little training, is intuitive and logical to a project manager and has a clearly organized system for document storage and retrieval. Best of all, it was designed to be affordable for small to mid-size construction firms. 

The central element of Construction Pro Manager is its patent-pending CLS-Contractor Linked System. It starts with three primary filing categories that are familiar to all project managers: Administrative, Technical and Field. Within each of these are a total of 42 construction-based logs and 23 essential forms, breakdowns and scheduling modules, which is an organizational structure that project managers and contractors already know intuitively, so they don’t need to learn an entirely new system or way of thinking.

The CLS-Contractor Linked System makes it easy to file and quickly retrieve such documents as project schedule, insurance, purchase order, requisition, request for proposal, email, operational & maintenance manual, contract drawings, equipment training, punch list, scope of work, accident report, daily time sheet, safety violation, inspection report and many others.

Construction Pro Manager is a password-protected, cloud-based application that can be used from desktop and laptop computers as well as with its view-only mobile application for smartphones and tablets.

It is subscription-based software that costs only $125–$175 per month, with annual, biannual and recurring monthly subscription options. Each subscription includes unlimited users per each contractor client, unlimited projects per each contractor client and daily technical support.

Construction Pro Manager was launched during 2014, and complete information about the product can be found at www.constructionpromanager.com.

Trestles Construction Solutions, LLC is composed of a group of construction and construction technology experts that are committed to enabling the improvement of construction crew safety, quality, productivity and schedule reliability performance. TLMS is a short interval planning, scheduling and reporting tool that is easy to learn and use, and is very affordable with an exceptional user experience. Our Frontline Supervisor Development program involves two-day sessions that cover Planning & Scheduling, Labor Management, Continuous Improvement and Effective Leadership.

With the shortages and ever-increasing demands placed on construction frontline supervisors, we believe providing them planning & scheduling education, leadership development, effective processes and tools to manage the work should be the primary objective of any construction firm that self-performs their work. 

Field supervisors are often talented craftsmen who have experienced “battle field promotions” without any formal training. Many of the project management tools are expensive, hard to learn and use and do not meet the needs of the field superior. Safety, quality, productivity, labor cost, retention of qualified crafts people and customer satisfaction is largely dependent on supporting your supervisors with the right "tools in their toolbox."​

Having sat in the estimator’s chair and having used nearly every major bid-management software available, he saw the flaws that existed in their products and companies. BuildBoss is a result of his experience and desire to create something infinitely better!

BuildBoss’s core product is a superior, feature-rich, bid management software for general contractors. With it, subscribers save time and money in a way otherwise only dreamed of by non-subscribers and subscribers of other bid management software. BuildBoss subscribers quickly set up projects with bid packages, find the right bidders, issue invitations to bid, and more –all in a smarter, faster way to save contractors time and money on the bid management process. 

Subcontractors and other types of bidders benefit from free access to the system. They quickly confirm their bid status, download project documents, submit questions and even securely submit their bids to general contractors. 

What makes BuildBoss superior to other bid management software is quickly seen. Since we believe in being transparent with our customers, our pricing is straightforward, consistent, and listed right on our website for everybody to see. 
BuildBoss subscribers have access to always organized and up-to-date information, uncompromised security, smarter search features, and the largest database of quality bidders available.

entity.name: Construction Pro Manager
entity.description:
Andrew Arena created a project management software that truly serves the needs of project managers, construction companies, clients, subcontractors and all other project participants. 

Construction Pro Manager requires very little training, is intuitive and logical to a project manager and has a clearly organized system for document storage and retrieval. Best of all, it was designed to be affordable for small to mid-size construction firms. 

The central element of Construction Pro Manager is its patent-pending CLS-Contractor Linked System. It starts with three primary filing categories that are familiar to all project managers: Administrative, Technical and Field. Within each of these are a total of 42 construction-based logs and 23 essential forms, breakdowns and scheduling modules, which is an organizational structure that project managers and contractors already know intuitively, so they don’t need to learn an entirely new system or way of thinking.

entity.name: SuperConstruct
entity.description:
SuperConstruct is an AI-powered construction management platform built to help contractors, developers, project managers, and owners simplify the way projects are managed, approved, and paid.

Created by construction professionals who experienced firsthand the challenges of fragmented systems, manual processes, and disconnected project data, SuperConstruct brings every critical workflow into one connected platform. From pay applications and lien waivers to daily logs, change orders, RFIs, and project reporting, teams gain complete visibility without the administrative burden that often slows projects down.

By connecting field teams, accounting departments, subcontractors, owners, lenders, and project stakeholders in a single environment, SuperConstruct creates a reliable source of truth for every project. The result is faster approvals, better collaboration, improved cash flow visibility, and more informed decision-making throughout the construction lifecycle.

Built with automation at its core, the platform helps reduce repetitive administrative tasks while improving compliance, accountability, and documentation management. Teams can streamline payment workflows, automate lien waiver processes, manage project communications, and maintain real-time access to critical project information from anywhere.

SuperConstruct integrates seamlessly with industry-leading tools including Procore, QuickBooks, and ChatGPT, helping organizations connect their existing workflows while unlocking the benefits of AI-powered construction management.

Today, SuperConstruct has helped process more than $60 million in payments, automate over 15,000 lien waivers, deliver an average of 35% cost savings, and reduce administrative workload by up to 30% for construction teams.

Built by Contractors. Powered by AI.

entity.name: DANAOS Projects Software Solutions LLC
entity.description:
DANAOS Projects Software Solutions LLC is the developer and owner of ProjectVIEW ERP, a construction-specific, project-centric ERP system designed to solve one problem generic ERPs consistently fail at: real cost control in complex projects.

ProjectVIEW ERP is purpose-built for contractors, EPC companies, shipyards, and project-driven manufacturers operating across infrastructure, energy, data centers, offshore, marine, mining, project-based manufacturing, and industrial construction.

Unlike generic ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, Infor, IFS, Sage, Dynamics) that are accounting-centric, ProjectVIEW ERP is built around the project itself, continuously benchmarking Cost and Time through the BoQ–WBS–Cost Code relationship.

This enables real-time visibility into budget vs actuals, procurement-driven forecasting, earned value deviations, and corrective action — before overruns escalate.

What defines ProjectVIEW ERP:

Construction & project-centric ERP (not finance-first)

Real-time cost control driven by BoQ, WBS, and procurement

Native support for EPC, infrastructure, shipbuilding, and project-based manufacturing

Integrated planning, procurement, subcontractors, site operations, and analytics

Seamless integration with Primavera, BIM, and corporate ERPs (SAP / Oracle)

DANAOS Projects operates internationally, with offices in Greece, Dubai, and the Philippines, serving enterprise-grade project organizations seeking control, predictability, and profitability across the full CAPEX → OPEX → asset lifecycle.

ProjectVIEW ERP is not a generic ERP adapted for construction.
It is a construction ERP engineered by construction professionals.
